product.olivetti-m380-xp4.summary: The 25 MHz M380/XP branch, with seven positions compared with the XP7’s ten.
product.olivetti-m380-xp4.history: The documentation places M380/XP4 as the 25 MHz M380/XP branch, with seven positions compared with the XP7’s ten.
product.olivetti-m380-xp4.architecture: Memory organisation determines expansion options. The guide identifies BA842 / BA829. The board supports 4–8 MB and additional expansion uses memory boards.
product.olivetti-m380-xp4.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records BA829: 1.05 · PBU5/PBU4 / 1.07 · PBZ1/PBZ0.
product.olivetti-m380-xp4.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m380-xp4.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m380-xp4.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 9-1–9-3.
